review.title: To review
review.sub: Two profiles that may be one person, side by side. Only a person merges; nothing moves or is deleted, and a merge can be split again.
review.off: Merge suggestions are switched off in the customer settings. You can still merge two profiles by hand from a customer's page.
review.noRules: No merge rule is chosen, so nothing is suggested.
review.emptyBody: When two profiles share an e-mail, a WhatsApp number, or a name with the same address, they show here.
review.emptyDoneBody: Every merge, split and "not the same person" is kept here with who decided and why.
review.more: Showing {shown} of {total}. Decide these first; the next ones then show.
review.handNone: These two profiles cannot be shown side by side (one is missing, or it is the same profile).
review.readOnly: You can see the suggestions; merging needs the "Merge customers" permission.

merge.eff1: The second profile shows inside the first one; its orders, wallet and notes stay where they are.
merge.eff2: Nothing is deleted and no money moves.
merge.eff3: It can be split again, with a reason; both steps stay in the log.
merge.notSameDone: This pair will not be suggested again.

err.default: That did not work. Please try again.
err.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
err.NOT_FOUND: This customer or decision no longer exists. Reload the page.
err.SAME_PROFILE: A profile cannot be merged with itself.
err.ALREADY_MERGED: One of them is already merged into another profile. Merge with that one instead.
err.HAS_MERGED: Other profiles are merged into this one; it can only be the one that stays.
err.NOT_ACTIVE: An archived or erased profile is never merged.
err.NOTE_REQUIRED: The merge rules ask for a short note.
err.MOVED_ON: This profile was merged again elsewhere; undo that merge instead.
err.KEY_REUSED: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
err.NAME_TAKEN: Another segment already has this name.
err.LIMIT_REACHED: That is more than the settings allow. Archive one first, or raise the number in Segment settings.
err.STALE: Someone else saved this in the meantime. Reload the page.
err.SWITCHED_OFF: This is switched off in the settings.
err.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI writer did not answer or gave nothing usable. Try again, or write it yourself.

list.title: All customers
list.sub: One row per person, by phone. Opening a customer and copying a number are logged.

kpi.peopleNote: one row per person, however many numbers
kpi.refusedNote: not counting the shop's own mistakes

empty.title: No customer matches
empty.body: Try a shorter name or the last digits of the phone, or clear the filters.
empty.noneBody: Every order makes or finds its customer by phone; they show here.

profile.merged: This profile was merged into {name}. You are seeing the person it belongs to.

kpi.refusedNote: {n} more were the shop's own mistake, not counted
kpi.refusedNoteNone: at the door, not the shop's fault

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.masked: Only people allowed the full number see it.

profiles.title: Profiles of this person
profiles.review: Split or check in To review

support.title: Support history
support.none: No conversation or ticket yet. The support desk will fill this.

profile.address: The address is shown only inside an order.

mergeWith.label: The other profile's phone
mergeWith.same: That number is this person's own.

profile.notFound: This customer does not exist (or was erased).

seg.title: Segments
seg.sub: Groups of customers by what they really did. Saved by name and used again in the Customers list and, later, in campaigns.
seg.offBody: Turn them on under More options below. Nothing is counted or saved while they are off.
seg.offAsk: Segments are switched off. Ask the owner to turn them on.
seg.noneYet: None yet. Press New segment to make one.
seg.builtInSub: The Customers list's own views, counted the same way. Each one opens that view.
seg.unreadable: This segment was saved by a newer version and cannot be read here.
seg.archiveEff1: It leaves Your segments and stops being counted.
seg.archiveEff2: Nothing is deleted: Restore it from More options on the Segments page.
seg.readOnly: You can try conditions here; saving needs the segments permission.
seg.listGone: This segment is archived, switched off or no longer exists, so nobody is shown.

b.title: Segment builder
b.sub: Conditions are joined with “and”. The count updates as you change them.
b.archivedNote: This segment is archived. Restore it from More options on the Segments page to change it.
b.name: Name
b.and: A customer is in the segment when every condition below is true. An empty condition is skipped.
b.noAreas: No districts in the address list yet
b.bad: Not a valid value: this condition is skipped until it is fixed.
b.most: At most {n} conditions in one segment.

field.lastOrderOver: Last order more than … days ago
field.joinedWithin: First came in the last … days

jr.offBody: Turn it on in Customers › More › Customer settings.
jr.firstNone: Not known: no touch carries a source or a campaign.
jr.title: Journey

profile.other: Another profile of his made · from {source}

merge.notSame: Marked as not the same person as another profile

set.title: Customer settings
set.sub: The customer features, each off until you turn it on. Every change is kept in the log.
set.readOnly: Only someone with the customer settings permission can change these.

journey.title: Customer journey view
journey.sub: The Journey tab on a customer's page: every touch of that person in order, newest first. Nothing new is stored.

opt.profile: Profiles and where they came from
opt.wallet: Wallet (only for those who see money)

automations.title: Automation settings
automations.sub: Off as shipped. Every journey is also saved off.
automations.perCustomerPerWeek: Most journey messages to one person in 7 days
automations.catchUpDays: Days back a start may reach when a journey is turned on
automations.batchSize: Most people moved in one run

email.title: E-mail settings
email.sub: Off as shipped. Tracking is off until you turn it on.
email.perCustomerPerWeek: Most offer e-mails to one person in 7 days
email.batchSize: Most people queued in one run (the throttle)
email.trackOpens: Count opens (a tiny image in the e-mail)
email.resultDays: Result days (orders within these days count)

aiWriter.title: AI campaign writer
aiWriter.sub: Off as shipped; it also needs AI for the whole shop. "Write with AI" on an offer e-mail gives 2 or 3 versions in your voice. It only fills the form: you pick, check and save.

style.bn: How you talk (Bengali), a few words
style.en: How you talk (English), a few words

auto.title: Automations
auto.sub: Customer journeys that run by themselves: a reminder when a product is likely used up, a win-back after a quiet spell, a welcome. Each one is off until you turn it on.
auto.offerNote: Every journey message is an offer: it goes only to customers who said yes to offers on that channel, never in the quiet hours, and at most the weekly limit per person. The stop line is added.
auto.offBody: Turn them on under "More options" below (Automation settings). Nothing is sent until you also turn a journey on.
auto.offAsk: Automations are off. Someone with the right to build them can turn them on.
auto.unreadable: This journey cannot be read; open it and save it again.

triggerHelp.delivered: The product-life reminder: each delivered order starts it once, the chosen number of days after delivery.
triggerHelp.noOrder: The win-back: a customer whose last order is this many days old starts it once for that quiet spell.
triggerHelp.joined: The welcome: a new profile starts it once, this many days after it was made.

auto.onEff1: Customers who fit the start from now on (and from the last few days) join it.
auto.onEff2: Its messages go only to those who said yes to offers.
auto.archiveEff1: It goes off and everyone on it stops. Nothing is deleted.
auto.archiveEff2: You can restore it from "More options".

b.title: Journey
b.sub: What starts it, then each step in order.
b.name: Name
b.noTemplates: No template on this channel yet (Messages › Templates)
b.exitOnOrder: Leave the journey when he places a new order
b.offerNote: Every message here is an offer: it needs the customer's yes for offers on that channel.
b.readOnly: You can see this journey; changing it needs the right to build automations.
b.archivedNote: This journey is archived. Restore it from the Automations page under "More options".

mail.title: E-mail
mail.sub: Offer e-mails to a saved segment, from your own templates, with what happened to each.
mail.offerNote: Every e-mail here is an offer: it goes only to customers who said yes to offer e-mails, never in the quiet hours, at most the weekly limit per person, and always with the unsubscribe line.
mail.offBody: Turn it on under "More options" below (E-mail settings). Nothing is sent until you also schedule a send.
mail.offAsk: E-mail marketing is off. Someone with the right to write e-mails can turn it on.
mail.noTemplates: No template yet. A template is the subject and words you start a send from.
mail.everyone: Everyone with a yes for offer e-mails
mail.words: You can use {customerName}, {storeName} and {link} (the shop's home page). Links you type are counted when click tracking is on.

s.sub: Who gets it → the words → when. Before it goes you see how many it reaches and why the rest are left out.
s.name: Name
s.segmentsOff: Saved segments are off, so a send goes to everyone with a yes for offer e-mails.
s.subject: Subject
s.readOnly: You can see this send; changing it needs the right to write e-mails.
s.reachLine: {reachable} will get it · {noEmail} have no e-mail · {noYes} have not said yes to offer e-mails (left out)
s.reachProblem: The segment cannot be counted (archived, or saved segments are off). Pick another one.
s.scheduleEff1: {n} customers get it (at the moment it goes, anyone who stopped is left out)
s.scheduleEff2: It waits for the quiet hours to end and goes at the throttle
s.scheduleEff3: You can pause or cancel it any time; e-mails already sent stay sent
s.cancelEff1: Every e-mail still waiting is left out
s.cancelEff2: E-mails already sent stay sent; this cannot be resumed
s.noSendRight: Scheduling needs the right to send e-mails.
s.draftOnly: A send can be changed only while it is a draft.
s.resultNote: An order counts when a receiver places it within the result days after his e-mail; its value counts only once delivered.

t.sub: A subject and words you start an e-mail send from.
t.name: Name
t.readOnly: You can see this template; changing it needs the right to write e-mails.
t.archivedNote: This template is archived. Restore it from the E-mail page under "More options".

ai.briefPh: e.g. New winter polos, ten colours, free exchange for a week
ai.briefHelp: A line or two in your words. The versions come in {lang}, in your voice from Customer settings.
ai.practice: Practice text: no AI provider is connected yet, so these only join your own words.
ai.used: Put into the form. Check it, change it if you like, then save.
